name: new-term-radar
description: Three skills that find the names of new AI models, products and repositories as they surface, and size the search terms behind them with Google Ads volume and DataForSEO Trends, an estimate of Google search interest.

glasser_api_key.title: Glasser API key
glasser_api_key.description: First choice for the radar's paid data: Google Ads volumes, DataForSEO Trends, Google results, domain data, Reddit and YouTube. recent_leads works without it. A key: https://link.glasser.ai/JasonZhuX (referral link)

aisa_api_key.title: AIsa API key
aisa_api_key.description: For what Glasser does not sell: X posts and the model that judges names. Without a Glasser key, all the paid data goes through it too. A key: https://aisa.one

goanyapi_api_key.title: GoAnyAPI API key (optional)
goanyapi_api_key.description: Optional: what people searched together with each name, and one country's daily Trends series. A key: https://goanyapi.com
